C9000148.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 148 (The entropy-rate dimension formula for self-similar measures.; papers: The entropy-rate dimension formula for self-similar measures on the line; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/148.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_PAIR_BOUND.statement: For every finite real probability law, integer k >= 1, and rho > 0, k(H(nu)-H^0_rho(nu)) <= log_2 |k supp(nu)| + 60000 k^4 sum_{2^(-ell) <= 2 rho} c_ell(nu), with fractional unordered-pair capacity and no minimum-separation hypothesis.
C_PAIR_BOUND.dependency_discharge: The unchanged unconditional compiler certificate contains the four internal pair-bound obligations. Host-invoked reviewer:copilot approved this exact certificate; the theorem is now an atomic reviewed input, not a pending reproof.

L_PAIR_CHAIN.statement: The finite conditional-entropy chain reduces the exact-minus-grid entropy deficit to at most log_2 |kF| plus refinement costs, using separation only to obtain a finite terminal depth.

L_PAIR_REFINEMENT.statement: A refinement after observing the sum has a linear mean-deviation cost; coordinate independence is used only before conditioning on the sum.

L_PAIR_COUPLING.statement: A symmetric same-cell coupling has the original marginals, and its mass in each half-open dyadic distance band gives a feasible fractional unordered-pair mixture.

L_PAIR_CHARGING.statement: Each dyadic band is charged by a geometric series with uniform bound 8/3, eliminating the separating depth and giving the stated constant.

C_DIMENSION_FORMULA.statement: The dimension of every finite real self-similar measure with positive weights and 0 < |r_i| < 1 is min(1,h_RW/chi), allowing signed contractions, exact overlaps, and repeated indexed maps.

L_EXACT_DIMENSION.statement: Feng-Hu exact dimensionality supplies existence of the dimension of the self-similar measure.

L_NONSATURATION.statement: For dimension below one, the manuscript's entropy increment is uniformly nonsaturated at all scales.

L_TYPE_DEFICIT.statement: Block-type conditioning produces conditional finite laws with a linear exact-minus-grid entropy deficit.

L_PAIR_BANDS.statement: The finite-law pair bound converts type-conditioned entropy deficit to a positive average total pair capacity over finitely many finer bands.

L_CONDITIONAL_GAIN.statement: Fair pairs and nonsaturation yield a definite conditional entropy gain on the associated windows.

L_WINDOW_CONTRADICTION.statement: Disjoint-window entropy gains telescope to exclude dimension below both one and h_RW/chi.

L_DIMENSION_UPPER.statement: Merged complete affine-map blocks give dimension at most min(1,h_RW/chi), including zero entropy.

L_ENTROPY_CALCULUS.statement: Uniform smoothing and nested grids give signed scaling, integer-ratio concavity, convolution monotonicity, grid comparisons, and convexity of the one-bit deficit.

L_ENTROPY_DIMENSION.statement: The fixed and averaged grid entropy upper rates of a compact exact-dimensional real measure are at most its dimension.

L_TWO_POINT_GAIN.statement: A fair pair of distance v gains at least Delta_v-s/v-v/t in a window 0<s<v<t, including translated and reflected pairs.

L_DIMENSION_WINDOW_CORE.statement: Universal ceiling-error, cross-band ordering, ordered-window telescoping, integer target recovery, floor-count, adaptive endpoint, and arbitrary-band contradiction theorems.
